instruction:
Background: An office Linux host is running a local CUPS server (listening on `http://localhost:631/`). Two virtual print queues `EyesonPDF` (cups-pdf backend) and `EyesonRaw` (custom PPD + custom filter) have recently started "eating jobs without producing output" — all PDFs submitted by colleagues stop in `stopped` / `held` state, the CUPS Web UI shows a red/yellow banner at the top, but the queue summary alone doesn't reveal the cause; only by clicking into the *Show Active Jobs* page can the reason string of each job give a rough direction. You need to clean up both queues in one go.

Environment (warmup already prepared):
- CUPS is started, both queues `EyesonPDF` / `EyesonRaw` are already created;
- PPD is at `/etc/cups/ppd/EyesonRaw.ppd`, filter is at `/usr/lib/cups/filter/eyeson_wrap`;
- Test PDFs are at `/tmp_workspace/jobs/sample_a4.pdf`, `sample_letter.pdf`;
- Helper script `bash /tmp_workspace/cups/observe.sh <out_dir>` will write current `lpstat` / `lpoptions` snapshots to `<out_dir>/lpstat_<timestamp>.txt`.
- You have sudo; you may not delete cupsd or reset `/etc/cups`, only restart is allowed.

Deliverables to produce under `/tmp_workspace/results/`:

1. **Queue status snapshots** — at least two `lpstat_*.txt` files: one before the repair (`before`), and one after all repairs are complete and newly submitted jobs have finished (named `lpstat_after.txt`). Either file must present an `lpstat`-style queue/Job listing.

2. **Configuration excerpt** — `ppd_excerpt.txt`: extract the key sections for `EyesonRaw` and `EyesonPDF` from `/etc/cups/ppd/EyesonRaw.ppd` and `/etc/cups/printers.conf` (not the full text); the file length must be > 200 bytes, and **both queue names must appear**.

3. **Error log window** — `cups_error_log.txt`: capture the CUPS error_log lines from the time window when the problem occurred (typically `tail -n 200 /var/log/cups/error_log`); the file length must be > 100 bytes and must contain at least one of `E ` / `W ` / `filter` / `stopped` / `EyesonRaw` / `EyesonPDF`.

4. **Offline filter reproduction** — reproduce the failure using one "offline filter chain":
   - `cupsfilter_before.ps`: the PostScript output of running the original PPD + test PDF (may be empty, but the file must exist);
   - `cupsfilter_before.err`: stderr of the same run; must contain at least one of the keywords `duplex` / `filter` / `support` / `exit` / `fail`.

5. **Visual evidence** (must be captured from a real working environment; the text on screen must be clearly readable):
   - `view_cups_jobs_red_banner.png`: the `EyesonRaw` queue page in the CUPS Web UI; the image must show a *Stopped* / *Paused* status bar or a red banner at the top; on-screen text must contain one of `EyesonRaw` / `Stopped` / `Paused` / `CUPS`.
   - `view_cups_set_default_options.png`: the *Set Default Options* page for `EyesonRaw` in the CUPS Web UI; the image must show the Duplex and PageSize dropdown selectors; on-screen text must contain one of `Duplex` / `PageSize` / `Default` / `EyesonRaw`.
   - `view_system_config_printer_panel.png`: the properties view of `EyesonPDF` in the system printer management panel; must show *Printer Options* / the current default paper setting; on-screen text must contain one of `EyesonPDF` / `Properties` / `Page` / `Paper` / `Options`.
   - `view_lpstat_terminal_before.png`: pre-repair queue status (including `disabled` / `stopped` lines); on-screen text must contain one of `lpstat` / `disabled` / `stopped` / `Eyeson`.
   - `view_postrepair_completed_jobs.png`: post-repair *Show Completed Jobs* view; the image must show at least 2 *completed* records; on-screen text must contain one of `completed` / `Completed` / `EyesonRaw` / `EyesonPDF`.

6. **Structured diagnosis** — `diagnosis.json`: a JSON array with **two records** (one per queue); each schema:
   ```json
   {
     "queue": "EyesonRaw | EyesonPDF",
     "category": "ppd_default_option | media_mismatch | filter_logic | other",
     "evidence_cli": ["cups_error_log.txt:line_number", "cupsfilter_before.err summary"],
     "evidence_gui": "view_cups_set_default_options.png",
     "root_cause": "one-sentence diagnosis",
     "fix_command": "lpadmin / lpoptions / sed command string"
   }
   ```
   The `category` field must be one of the four choices; both queue names must be covered.

7. **Post-repair filter re-verification**:
   - `cupsfilter_after.ps`: the PostScript produced by running the offline filter again after the repair; file size > 200 bytes;
   - `cupsfilter_after.err`: the stderr of the same run; **must not** contain the words `error` / `fail`.

8. **Regression submission**: after the repair, submit one compliant test job to each of the two queues (PageSize / Duplex etc. parameters must match the post-repair default values), wait until both reach completed, then take another status snapshot (`lpstat_after.txt` from step 1); that snapshot must contain at least 2 `completed` lines and 0 `stopped` / `disabled` lines.

9. **Report** — `report.md` (≥ 60 lines):
   Must contain six sections: "queue topology / symptoms / evidence collection / root cause / fix / re-verification" (Chinese or English keywords are both accepted); each section must cite the corresponding evidence file; copying the root cause verbatim into the report's title is not allowed.

Hard constraints:
- `rm -rf /etc/cups` is not allowed; stopping cupsd is not allowed (only restart);
- The semantics of legal Duplex options in the PPD must not be broken;
- Red herring: in `/etc/cups/ppd/EyesonRaw.ppd` the PPD spec only allows switching the default value or making the filter accept the legal value; wholesale replacement of the PPD is not allowed.

parameters.warmup:
mkdir -p /tmp_workspace/results /tmp_workspace/state /tmp_workspace/jobs /opt/dsk13_gt
chmod 1777 /tmp_workspace/results /tmp_workspace/state /tmp_workspace/jobs 2>/dev/null || true
chmod 700 /opt/dsk13_gt 2>/dev/null || true
cat > /opt/dsk13_gt/expected.json <<'JSON'
{
  "queues": ["EyesonPDF", "EyesonRaw"],
  "expected_root_causes": [
    {"queue": "EyesonRaw", "category": "ppd_default_option", "keywords": ["Duplex","DuplexNoTumble","filter-failed","PPD"]},
    {"queue": "EyesonPDF", "category": "media_mismatch",     "keywords": ["media","A5","A4","PageSize","Letter"]}
  ],
  "min_findings": 2,
  "post_repair_required": {"no_stopped_jobs": true, "completed_jobs_min": 2, "cupsfilter_returncode": 0},
  "expected_screens": ["view_cups_jobs_red_banner.png","view_cups_set_default_options.png","view_system_config_printer_panel.png","view_lpstat_terminal_before.png","view_postrepair_completed_jobs.png"],
  "min_cross_channel_switches": 5,
  "min_lpstat_snapshots": 2
}
JSON
chmod 600 /opt/dsk13_gt/expected.json 2>/dev/null || true
chown -R root:root /opt/dsk13_gt 2>/dev/null || true
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
export DISPLAY=${DISPLAY:-:0}
which python3 || (apt-get update -o Acquire::Retries=10 -qq && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -o Acquire::Retries=10 -y -qq python3 python3-pip tesseract-ocr poppler-utils ghostscript) || true
pip install -q --break-system-packages reportlab pillow pytesseract 2>/dev/null || pip install -q reportlab pillow pytesseract 2>/dev/null || true
python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import pathlib
B = "c" + "u" + "p" + "s"
ppd_dir = pathlib.Path("/etc") / B / "ppd"
ppd_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
conf_path = pathlib.Path("/etc") / B / "printers.conf"
log_dir = pathlib.Path("/var/log") / B
log_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
ppd = '''*PPD-Adobe: "4.3"
*FormatVersion: "4.3"
*FileVersion: "1.0"
*LanguageVersion: English
*PCFileName: "EYESONRAW.PPD"
*Manufacturer: "Eyeson"
*Product: "(EyesonRaw)"
*ModelName: "EyesonRaw"
*NickName: "EyesonRaw Virtual Queue"
*PSVersion: "(3010.000) 0"
*LanguageLevel: "3"
*ColorDevice: True
*DefaultColorSpace: RGB
*OpenUI *PageSize/Media Size: PickOne
*OrderDependency: 10 AnySetup *PageSize
*DefaultPageSize: A4
*PageSize A4/A4: "<</PageSize[595 842]/ImagingBBox null>>setpagedevice"
*PageSize Letter/US Letter: "<</PageSize[612 792]/ImagingBBox null>>setpagedevice"
*CloseUI: *PageSize
*OpenUI *Duplex/2-Sided Printing: PickOne
*OrderDependency: 10 AnySetup *Duplex
*DefaultDuplex: DuplexNoTumble
*Duplex None/Off: "<</Duplex false>>setpagedevice"
*Duplex DuplexNoTumble/Long Edge: "<</Duplex true/Tumble false>>setpagedevice"
*CloseUI: *Duplex
*%% Filter eyeson_wrap rejects DuplexNoTumble when PageSize=Letter (broken default)
'''
(ppd_dir / "EyesonRaw.ppd").write_text(ppd)
conf = '''# Printer configuration file written by warmup
NextPrinterId 3
<DefaultPrinter EyesonPDF>
UUID urn:uuid:eyeson-pdf-0001
Info Eyeson Virtual PDF Queue
Location Local
MakeModel Generic PDF Printer
DeviceURI pdf:/
State Stopped
StateMessage "Filter failed: media mismatch"
StateTime 1714000000
ConfigTime 1713999000
Accepting Yes
Shared No
JobSheets none none
QuotaPeriod 0
PageLimit 0
KLimit 0
OpPolicy default
ErrorPolicy stop-printer
Option media A5
</DefaultPrinter>
<Printer EyesonRaw>
UUID urn:uuid:eyeson-raw-0002
Info Eyeson Raw Virtual Queue
Location Local
MakeModel EyesonRaw Virtual Queue
DeviceURI file:///dev/null
State Stopped
StateMessage "Filter eyeson_wrap stopped: Duplex DuplexNoTumble unsupported on Letter"
StateTime 1714000100
ConfigTime 1713999100
Accepting Yes
Shared No
JobSheets none none
OpPolicy default
ErrorPolicy stop-printer
</Printer>
'''
conf_path.write_text(conf)
log = '''I [01/May/2026:10:00:01 +0000] [Job 101] Starting filter chain for EyesonRaw.
W [01/May/2026:10:00:02 +0000] [Job 101] Unsupported Duplex value "DuplexNoTumble" on PageSize Letter.
E [01/May/2026:10:00:02 +0000] [Job 101] Filter "eyeson_wrap" stopped (exit status 1)
E [01/May/2026:10:00:02 +0000] [Job 101] EyesonRaw stopped: filter exit code 1
W [01/May/2026:10:00:05 +0000] [Job 102] EyesonPDF: media A5 mismatch with submitted A4 page.
E [01/May/2026:10:00:05 +0000] [Job 102] EyesonPDF stopped: media mismatch.
I [01/May/2026:10:00:30 +0000] Printer "EyesonRaw" stopped by scheduler.
I [01/May/2026:10:00:31 +0000] Printer "EyesonPDF" stopped by scheduler.
'''
(log_dir / "error_log").write_text(log)
pathlib.Path("/tmp_workspace/state/lpstat_stub.txt").write_text(
    'printer EyesonPDF disabled since Wed 01 May 2026 10:00:31 -\n'
    '        Filter failed: media mismatch\n'
    'printer EyesonRaw disabled since Wed 01 May 2026 10:00:30 -\n'
    '        Filter eyeson_wrap stopped (Duplex DuplexNoTumble unsupported on Letter)\n'
)
out = pathlib.Path("/tmp_workspace/jobs"); out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
try:
    from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas
    from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import A4, letter
    for name, ps in (("sample_a4.pdf", A4), ("sample_letter.pdf", letter)):
        p = out / name
        if not p.exists():
            c = canvas.Canvas(str(p), pagesize=ps)
            c.drawString(72, 720, "Eyeson sample: " + name)
            c.showPage(); c.save()
except Exception:
    for name in ("sample_a4.pdf", "sample_letter.pdf"):
        p = out / name
        if not p.exists():
            p.write_bytes(b"%PDF-1.4\n%EOF\n")
PYEOF
ls -l /etc/c"ups"/ppd/EyesonRaw.ppd /etc/c"ups"/printers.conf /var/log/c"ups"/error_log 2>/dev/null || true
echo "[warmup-dsk13] done"
